Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Transgenes were induced with 1 ug/mL doxycycline for 4 days.
Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: Human dermal fibroblasts from a healthy 96-year old male donor (GM00731, Coriell) were cultured in Minimum Essential Medium (ThermoFisher) with 15% fetal bovine serum (Omega Scientific), and 1Ã non-essential amino acids solution (ThermoFisher) on 0.1% gelatin.
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted with the MagMAX mirVana Total RNA Isolation Kit (ThermoFisher) using the Kingfisher Apex System (ThermoFisher). 100 ng of total RNA was used for the construction of sequencing libraries.
RNA libraries were prepared using the Watchmaker mRNA Library Prep Kit (Watchmaker Genomics) following manufacturer's protocols and indexed with primers from xGEN UDI 10nt Primer Plate 5 (IDT).
Sample_data_processing: Raw fastq files were processed using the nf-core/rnaseq pipeline. Raw reads were assessed using FastQC. Adapter sequences and low-quality bases were removed using Trim Galore!. Cleaned reads were aligned to the reference genome GRCh38 using STAR. Transcript quantification was performed using Salmon, followed by gene-level summarization using tximport. Gene count matrices were imported into R and used as input for analysis by DESeq2 (v1.44.0).
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: csv file includes raw counts for each Sample
